categories.main_business_segments: Cosmax, Inc. is primarily engaged in cosmetics ODM (Original Development & Design Manufacturing), focusing on research, development, and manufacturing of cosmetic products including skincare, color cosmetics, and mask sheets. The company also operates in related sectors such as pharmaceutical manufacturing, medical devices, household goods, and AI-based platform services. Over 90% of its revenue is generated through ODM services, supplying global brands and domestic customers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Cosmax employs advanced R&D capabilities with about 25% of employees in research, operating a global R&I Center for new raw materials and product formulation development. It holds numerous certifications including CGMP, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 22716, FDA OTC, and ECOCERT, ensuring high-quality and compliant production. The company integrates AI and data-driven technologies for personalized beauty solutions and operates full-stack platforms linking diagnosis, prescription, and production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves global cosmetic brands including major groups from Europe, the US, and Japan, as well as over 1,300 domestic and Asian brand companies. Key customers include L Group, E Group, S Group, and others, spanning premium and mass-market segments. It targets markets in Asia, China, Southeast Asia, the US, Europe, and Latin America, supplying both offline and rapidly growing online channels.
categories.geographic_coverage: Cosmax operates globally with production facilities and subsidiaries in South Korea, China (Shanghai, Guangzhou), the United States (New Jersey), Indonesia, Thailand, and offices in Vietnam and Malaysia. Its products are exported to over 100 countries worldwide, with strong presence in Asia, North America, Europe, and Latin America. The company strategically locates manufacturing near key markets to enhance responsiveness and market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: Cosmax operates primarily as an upstream ODM manufacturer in the cosmetics supply chain, responsible for product research, development, and manufacturing. It supplies finished products directly to brand owners and retailers, acting as a critical partner in product innovation and production rather than retail or distribution. The company also manages raw material procurement and production logistics within its operations.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in personalized and AI-driven beauty solutions, exemplified by its 3WAAU platform for customized skincare and haircare products. It invests heavily in R&D to develop new formulations and functional cosmetics, maintaining a competitive edge through global trend adaptation and technology partnerships. Sustainability and renewable energy adoption, including solar power installations, are also strategic priorities to enhance operational efficiency and environmental responsibility.
categories.revenue_model: Cosmax generates revenue predominantly through ODM product sales, supplying finished cosmetic products developed and manufactured for client brands. Sales are conducted via direct contracts with domestic and international brand companies, with payment terms including cash, notes, T/T, and L/C for exports. The company also earns revenue from related services such as AI platform operations and technology licensing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Cosmax is positioned as the world's largest cosmetics ODM company by sales, with a strong competitive advantage in R&D, quality certifications, and global manufacturing footprint. It competes with other major ODM and OEM firms but differentiates itself through innovation, scale, and comprehensive service offerings. Its client base includes top global cosmetic groups, reinforcing its leadership in the industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, Cosmax reported consolidated revenues of approximately KRW 1.78 trillion with operating income of KRW 115.7 billion and net income of KRW 37.8 billion. The company has shown growth in sales and profitability compared to prior years, supported by expanding global operations and new business initiatives. Total assets exceed KRW 1.55 trillion, with a workforce of over 700 R&D personnel globally, reflecting a large-scale and mature enterprise.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Cosmax offers high-quality, innovative cosmetic products developed through advanced R&D and global trend insights, enabling clients to rapidly respond to market changes. Its extensive certifications and global manufacturing infrastructure ensure reliable supply and compliance with international standards. The company’s AI-based personalized beauty platform and commitment to sustainability further differentiate it by providing customized solutions and environmentally responsible production.
